02 / Strategy Suite

Four vectors.
One gravitational force.

001

Statistical Arbitrage

Mean-reversion strategies exploiting temporary deviations in correlated assets. Machine learning models trained on 20+ years of cross-asset microstructure data.

002

Options Alpha

Volatility surface arbitrage and dynamic delta-neutral structures that harvest risk premia across the options term structure.

003

Alternative Data

Satellite imagery, tick-historical and high-frequency WebSockets real-time market depth data at 4nm/sec frequency, sentiment NLP and supply chain analytics feed real-time signals into our ensemble alpha engine.

004

Crypto Alpha

Market-neutral strategies across digital asset ecosystems: funding rate harvesting, on-chain analytics and cross-exchange arbitrage.
